messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] question about  QTL GENOTYPE PROBABILITY
parts:
What exactly are you trying to do? It would be helpful if you would include code.

The function calc.genoprob returns the input cross object with conditional genotype probabilities inserted. You need to assign the result to some object (generally, I'd assign it back to the cross object) if you want to make use of those results in any way. See the examples in the help files, and also look at the tutorials, e.g. http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/rqtltour2.pdf

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: question about  QTL GENOTYPE PROBABILITY
parts:
If you just typed

  calc.genoprob(cooking, step=1)

you'd get the message, "This is an object of class..."

but if you type

  cooking <- calc.genoprob(cooking, step=1)

you shouldn't get that message.

karl
